trainium_feasibility: Exact c5c source, LNC2/four ranks, depth 6, width 1024 and padded vocabulary 8192 create b1, t1, b5 and t5. Each 524288 x 128 BF16 table has 128 MiB of weights. Across four tables, weights, dense BF16 gradients and BF16 RMSProp second moments imply about 1.5 GiB per rank before temporary tensors, model state, activations and compiler memory. AdamW/Muon owner partitioning remains active; the RMSProp group is replicated and follows globally averaged, separately clipped gradients. Full-size CPU memory, Neuron HBM, collective timing, compile/startup and root-disk/checkpoint peaks are unmeasured. Both hosts remain below the disk floor, and trn22 has a human-reset breaker.
cheapest_falsifier: After static review and memory-qualified containment, run the exact c5c full-size four-rank, two-step CPU G2 with RMSProp trace and real prepare.py import. Reject on a wrong table set, missing/extra RMS calls, rank divergence, nonfinite trace, update recomputation error, unchanged table, or strict checkpoint-load failure before any native smoke.

success_criteria.quality: Use fresh-process public-20M/context-1024 against the valid trn22 c5c A0 control. A same-host delta <= -0.0006 nominates a trn21 replicate; the unchanged decide.py two-host adoption rule requires both deltas negative, mean <= -0.0010 and disagreement <= 0.0015, then human acknowledgement. A delta <= -0.010 or BPB < 0.975 is HOLD for independent cold replay/audit. No layer-1 increment is attributed until same-host A1 is measured.
success_criteria.throughput: Record completed steps, training seconds, steady-state step time, token rate and compile/startup cost against the same-host A0. If the step ratio is outside [0.90, 1.10], quality is CONFOUNDED under the unchanged decision rules.
